issues.concern: The headword '首' has two distinct meanings, 'neck' and 'dismissal/firing'. The current semantic tag 'body-part' only covers the first meaning. The second meaning, 'dismissal/firing', is not covered by any tag.
issues.suggestion: Add 'action' to the semantic tags to cover the 'dismissal/firing' meaning, as it refers to an action. The tag should be ['body-part', 'action'].
